title: The Secret Intelligence of Plants
hook: Plants can make decisions just like animals do.
script: Plants can make decisions just like animals do. Their complex nervous systems allow them to respond to their environment. The Mimosa pudica reacts to touch within seconds, folding its leaves. Some plants communicate through a network of fungi, sharing vital information. Plants like Arabidopsis thaliana can remember past drought conditions. The Venus flytrap can snap shut faster than the blink of an eye. Certain plants can detect sounds and respond to vibrations. Next time you see a plant, consider the hidden complexity within.
